projects.title: fem-verified
projects.description: A verification-first finite element project built on FEniCSx. A manufactured Poisson solution on a square and a Gmsh-generated L-shape, with observed convergence rates asserted in the test suite.

projects.title: DOU Laws and Provisional Measures
projects.description: An end-to-end ingestion pipeline for Brazil's federal gazette. It fetches, parses, normalizes, and stores publications, using content fingerprints to make inserts idempotent and an authenticated API to expose auditable results.

projects.title: Indicium Data Pipeline
projects.description: A containerized ELT pipeline across CSV sources and PostgreSQL databases, with per-table extractors and Airflow DAGs for repeatable execution.

projects.title: Hyperledger Fabric Smart Contract
projects.description: Deterministic chaincode for inventory registration and traceability, enforcing role-based access control and validating every state transition against invariants.
